name: Rootcast Apprenticeship
oracle_text:
Choose three. You may choose the same mode more than once.
• Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature.
• Create a token that's a copy of target token you control.
• Target player creates a 1/1 green Squirrel creature token.
• Target opponent sacrifices a nontoken artifact of their choice.
blocked_sentences: Choose three. You may choose the same mode more than once.

needs.what: a top-level choose_mode on a spell that picks a fixed number of modes (here exactly three) as a multiset, so one mode may be chosen more than once, with each chosen instance declaring its own mode-owned targets at cast time (601.2b/700.2d) -- e.g. three instances of 'Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature', each targeting a creature of its own (possibly the same one)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_mode's count/up_to picks a set of distinct mode indices (op_choose_mode executes sorted(chosen), each once). The only multiset path is `budget` (Season of Weaving), which is asked one mode at a time on resolution, so its modes cannot own targets -- the loader refuses a target 'mode' unless the tree is one top-level choose_mode answered at cast, and a target spec carries one fixed 'mode' index with no notion of a second instance of that mode. Using budget 3 with cost 1 per mode would drop every 'target' in all four bullets, and repeat/for_each cannot declare fresh targets per iteration.
